_comment: Lights: small WS2812B LEDs in the housing, one per session in the bar's order (pi/README.md, Lights). Off by default. Read at server start, only when the server is started with --lights-config (pi/revview.service does); the Settings row "Lights" turns them on or off until the server restarts. Untested on hardware.
_comment_brightness: The cap of each colour channel out of 255 (at most 64): about 20 mA per channel at 255, so 48 gives at most about 11 mA per LED. Night (the night look) uses the night value.
